96	def mark_rest_wavelength_axis(
97	    ax, zred, *, label=r"rest-frame vacuum wavelength [$\mathrm{\AA}$]", title=None
98	):
99	    """Top x axis in rest-frame wavelength, lambda_rest = lambda_obs / (1 + z).
100	
101	    The top axis is the bottom axis's twin: same tick size, same label form.
102	    The observed-frame ticks leave the top spine. With ``title`` the header is
103	    one row: title flush left, axis label flush right, on one baseline. Without
104	    it an existing centred title stays above the centred axis label. Call before
105	    ``spectral_tight_layout``.
106	    """
107	    top = ax.secondary_xaxis(
108	        "top", functions=(lambda obs: obs / (1 + zred), lambda rest: rest * (1 + zred))
109	    )
110	    ax.tick_params(axis="x", which="both", top=False)
111	    if title is None:
112	        top.set_xlabel(label)
113	        return top
114	    top.set_xlabel(label, loc="right")
115	    fig = ax.figure
116	    fig.draw_without_rendering()                       # places the top label
117	    renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
118	    baseline = top.xaxis.label.get_position()[1]       # display px
119	    axes_top = ax.get_window_extent(renderer).y1
120	    pad = (baseline - axes_top) * 72 / fig.dpi
121	    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", y=1.0, pad=pad)
122	    fig.draw_without_rendering()
123	    title_box = ax.title.get_window_extent(renderer)
124	    label_box = top.xaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer)
125	    if title_box.x1 > label_box.x0:
126	        # The row is too narrow for both: stack the title above the label.
127	        ax.set_title(title, loc="left", y=1.0, pad=pad + (label_box.height + 2) * 72 / fig.dpi)
128	    return top

138	def spectral_tight_layout(fig=None, *, rect=(0, 0, 1, 1), **kwargs):
139	    """Apply tight layout, with a separate column for the feature legend.
140	
141	    Figures without feature labels use normal tight layout. Repeated calls do
142	    not increase figure dimensions again. Existing top/bottom margins remain.
143	    """
144	    fig = plt.gcf() if fig is None else fig
145	    legend = next((leg for leg in fig.legends if leg.get_gid() == _LEGEND_GID), None)
146	    if legend is None:
147	        fig.tight_layout(rect=rect, **kwargs)
148	        return
149	    box = legend.get_window_extent(fig.canvas.get_renderer())
150	    column = box.width / fig.dpi + 0.35
151	    height = box.height / fig.dpi + 0.4
152	    if not hasattr(fig, "_absorption_base_size"):
153	        fig._absorption_base_size = tuple(fig.get_size_inches())
154	    width, original_height = fig._absorption_base_size
155	    fig.set_size_inches(width + column, max(original_height, height))
156	    right = min(rect[2], 1 - column / fig.get_figwidth())
157	    legend.set_bbox_to_anchor((1 - 0.05 / fig.get_figwidth(), (rect[1] + rect[3]) / 2))
158	    fig.tight_layout(rect=(rect[0], rect[1], right, rect[3]), **kwargs)

161	def _spread_labels(positions, minimum, low, high):
162	    """Nearest positions to sorted ``positions`` with ``minimum`` spacing, inside [low, high]."""
163	    steps = minimum * np.arange(len(positions))
164	    blocks = []
165	    for value in positions - steps:
166	        blocks.append([value, 1])
167	        while len(blocks) > 1 and blocks[-2][0] > blocks[-1][0]:
168	            mean, count = blocks.pop()
169	            total = blocks[-1][1] + count
170	            blocks[-1] = [(blocks[-1][0] * blocks[-1][1] + mean * count) / total, total]
171	    spread = np.concatenate([[mean] * count for mean, count in blocks])
172	    spread = np.maximum.accumulate(np.maximum(spread, low)) + steps
173	    return np.minimum(spread, high - steps[::-1])

176	def _draw_label_rail(rail, wave, labels, fan=0.25):
177	    """Rotated band names on ``rail``, with leaders to the true wavelength on both edges."""
178	    fig = rail.figure
179	    fontsize = mpl.rcParams["font.size"] - 1.5
180	    low, high = np.log10(rail.get_xlim())
181	    dex_per_in = (high - low) / (rail.get_position().width * fig.get_figwidth())
182	    spacing = 1.37 * fontsize / 72 * dex_per_in
183	    spots = 10 ** _spread_labels(np.log10(wave), spacing, low + spacing / 2, high - spacing / 2)
184	    texts = [
185	        rail.text(spot, 1 - fan - 0.03, label, rotation=90, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=fontsize)
186	        for spot, label in zip(spots, labels, strict=True)
187	    ]
188	    fig.draw_without_rendering()
189	    to_rail = rail.transData.inverted()
190	    style = dict(color="0.6", lw=0.6, solid_capstyle="butt", clip_on=False)
191	    for true, spot, text in zip(wave, spots, texts, strict=True):
192	        bottom = to_rail.transform((0, text.get_window_extent().y0))[1] - 0.025
193	        rail.plot([true, spot, spot], [1, 1 - fan, 1 - fan - 0.005], **style)
194	        rail.plot([spot, spot, true], [bottom, fan, 0], **style)

197	def plot_photometry_fit(
198	    labels, wave_eff, flux, uncertainty, model_q16, model_q50, model_q84, *,
199	    redshift, data_label, spectral_range=None, continuum=None, mask=None,
200	):
201	    """Photometry fit with a pull panel; band names sit on a rail between the panels.
202	
203	    Fluxes in microjansky, wavelengths in observed angstrom. ``spectral_range`` is the
204	    (min, max) of the fitted spectral pixels, ``continuum`` a (wavelength, flux) pair,
205	    ``mask`` False for a band outside the fit. Returns ``(fig, (ax_flux, ax_pull))``.
206	    """
207	    order = np.argsort(wave_eff)
208	    wave = np.asarray(wave_eff, dtype=float)[order] * 1e-4
209	    flux, sigma, q16, q50, q84 = (
210	        np.asarray(values, dtype=float)[order]
211	        for values in (flux, uncertainty, model_q16, model_q50, model_q84)
212	    )
213	    labels = [labels[index] for index in order]
214	    fitted = np.ones(len(wave), dtype=bool) if mask is None else np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool)[order]
215	    pull = (flux - q50) / sigma
216	    x_low, x_high = wave.min() * 0.84, wave.max() * 1.22
217	
218	    rail_in = 0.95
219	    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6 + rail_in))
220	    grid = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, height_ratios=[3 * 1.3, rail_in, 1.3], hspace=0)
221	    ax = fig.add_subplot(grid[0])
222	    rail = fig.add_subplot(grid[1], sharex=ax)
223	    ax_pull = fig.add_subplot(grid[2], sharex=ax)
224	
225	    if continuum is not None:
226	        continuum_wave, continuum_flux = (np.asarray(values) for values in continuum)
227	        shown = (continuum_wave * 1e-4 > x_low) & (continuum_wave * 1e-4 < x_high)
228	        ax.plot(continuum_wave[shown] * 1e-4, continuum_flux[shown], color="0.6", lw=0.8,
229	                label="median continuum")
230	    # Data on top with capped 1-sigma bars, since a 5% floor is shorter than a large marker.
231	    for pick, face, suffix in ((fitted, None, "fitted bands"), (~fitted, "none", "bands outside the fit")):
232	        if pick.any():
233	            ax.errorbar(wave[pick], flux[pick], yerr=sigma[pick], fmt="o", ms=3.5, color="tab:blue", mfc=face,
234	                        elinewidth=1.2, capsize=3, capthick=1.2, zorder=3,
235	                        label=rf"{data_label} {suffix}, $1\sigma$")
236	            ax_pull.scatter(wave[pick], pull[pick], edgecolors="tab:blue",
237	                            facecolors="tab:blue" if face is None else face)
238	    ax.errorbar(wave, q50, yerr=[q50 - q16, q84 - q50], fmt="s", ms=5, color="tab:red", alpha=0.75,
239	                elinewidth=0.8, zorder=2, label="joint Ceridwen, 16-84%")
240	    if spectral_range is not None:
241	        span = np.asarray(spectral_range) * 1e-4
242	        for panel in (ax, ax_pull):
243	            panel.axvspan(*span, facecolor="tab:purple", alpha=0.12, linewidth=0.0, zorder=-1)
244	            for boundary in span:
245	                panel.axvline(boundary, color="tab:purple", alpha=0.95, linewidth=1.5, linestyle="--",
246	                              zorder=1)
247	        ax.plot([], [], color="tab:purple", linewidth=1.5, linestyle="--",
248	                label="LEGA-C spectroscopic data range")
249	
250	    ax.set(xscale="log", yscale="log", xlim=(x_low, x_high), ylabel=r"$F_\nu$ [$10^{-29}$ cgs]")
251	    y_low, y_high = ax.get_ylim()
252	    set_plain_log_ticks(ax.yaxis, [tick for tick in (0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000) if y_low < tick < y_high])
253	    ax.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
254	    ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="lower right")
255	    ax_pull.axhline(0, color="0.5", lw=0.8)
256	    ax_pull.set(xlabel=r"observed vacuum wavelength [$\mu$m]", ylabel="pull")
257	    set_plain_log_ticks(
258	        ax_pull.xaxis, [tick for tick in (0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 1, 2, 4, 8) if x_low < tick < x_high]
259	    )
260	    top = mark_rest_wavelength_axis(ax, redshift, label=r"rest-frame vacuum wavelength [$\mu$m]")
261	    set_plain_log_ticks(
262	        top.xaxis,
263	        [tick for tick in (0.1, 0.15, 0.25, 0.4, 0.6, 1, 1.5, 2.5, 4)
264	         if x_low < tick * (1 + redshift) < x_high],
265	    )
266	    rail.set(ylim=(0, 1))
267	    rail.axis("off")
268	    fig.tight_layout(h_pad=0)
269	    _draw_label_rail(rail, wave, labels)
270	    return fig, (ax, ax_pull)
